desc: Implement monotonic-stack boundary passes (prev_le/next_lt for min, prev_ge/next_gt for max) with consistent tie-breaking so each subarray counts exactly one min and one max.
Implement the O(1) capped pair-count for a fixed index given L, R and cap k; handle L or R exceeding k and guarantee a nonzero arithmetic-series result.
Combine contributions as sum over i of nums[i]*(min_count+max_count) with Python big ints; keep total O(n) time.
Run sample tests and brute-force validation (k=1, k=n, all-equal, strictly monotonic, duplicates/negatives); verdict reported as pass with no counterexample.
